title: Fix Windsurf Hooks Configuration
prompt: The .windsurf/hooks.json file is missing, so Windsurf's native hook system never calls the semio-repo CLI hooks. Need to create the file with the correct Windsurf hook format (snake_case events) that pipes stdin JSON to the CLI for blocking checks (pre_run_command for git checkout/stash/reset blocking).
summary: Fixed two issues preventing Windsurf hooks from calling semio-repo CLI: (1) Created missing .windsurf/hooks.json with all 10 Windsurf hook events mapped to CLI commands. (2) Fixed exit code 2 bug: hookCommand returned pointer &ExitError{Code:2} but main() used errors.As with value type ExitError, causing match failure and fallthrough to os.Exit(1). Changed to ExitError{Code:2}. (3) Updated generateWindsurfConfig with show_output fields. All 27+ hook tests pass. Blocked commands (git checkout, git stash, git reset --hard, git clean -fd) verified returning exit code 2.

interactions.author: usalu
interactions.prompt: The .windsurf/hooks.json uses "tool.calling" for pre_mcp_tool_use and pre_run_command, but "tool.calling" is not a valid hook event. Valid events are: commit.starting, commit.ended, agent.starting, agent.ended, prompt.submit, compacting, tool.starting, tool.ended, task.plan, task.starting, task.ended, code.reading, code.edited, terminal.starting, terminal.ended. Fix pre_mcp_tool_use to use tool.starting and pre_run_command to use terminal.starting.
